app_info.subtitle: Stated vs. delivered, measured
app_info.description: Every Heuremen LLC plugin in one install: check papers and LLM eval claims against the Standards, query and reproduce every indahl.ai desk, check and correct IBM Quantum runs, test whether a plan was pushed before the first run, and check readings for a complete check block. Includes the indahl.ai data connector. Scripts are fetched from the public indahl.ai repository at pinned sha256; the version with bundled scripts and the automatic readcheck commit gate is indahl-full in the Heuremen-LLC/indahl.ai marketplace.

justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only indahl.ai's own public data and never writes to the internet or to any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, send or revoke anything; repeated calls return the same published data.

test_cases.description: Start with the list of what the app covers.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does indahl.ai measure? List its divisions.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists each division with a one-line description and its page, and explains the four outcomes.

test_cases.description: Read IBM's published calibration for one processor.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the median T1 and T2 on ibm_kingston right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the newest record stamp, qubit count and median T1, T2, readout and two-qubit error for ibm_kingston, with the record time.

test_cases.description: Check license claims for popular models.
test_cases.user_prompt: How often do the most downloaded Hugging Face models state a license that differs from their license file?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the disagreement share with its 95% interval and outcome, the counts by class, and examples read in full.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find studies on quantum error mitigation that QIA has indexed.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching studies with title, link, classification codes, date indexed and the receipt of what was read.

test_cases.description: Compare all live tests side by side.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show every live test on indahl.ai in one table, ordered by outcome.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one row per live page with what was compared, failures, share with 95% interval and outcome, ordered by outcome.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general coding help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of dictionaries by date.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside indahl.ai's published measurements.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move the 3pm?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside indahl.ai's published measurements.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for stock trading advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I buy IBM stock this week?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside indahl.ai's published measurements.
